Balanced barrel.

  •  Slightly increases handling speed

Weighty barrel extension.
  •  Increases range
  •  Decreases handling speed
  •  Moderately controls recoil

perks.name: Fluted Barrel
perks.desc:
Ultra-light barrel. 
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Full Bore
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for distance.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Hammer-Forged Rifling

Durable ranged barrel.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Polygonal Rifling
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for recoil reduction.
  •  Increases stability

Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Rifled Barrel

Ranged shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Greatly decreases handling speed

Speeds up charge.
  •  Faster charge time
  •  Decreases impact damage

Strong battery life.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Ionized Battery
perks.desc:
Large heavy battery.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed

perks.name: Liquid Coils
perks.desc:
Slower-building charge for higher damage.
  •  Increases impact damage
  •  Slower charge time

perks.name: Particle Repeater
perks.desc:
Improves stability. 
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Projection Fuse
perks.desc:
Distance optimizations.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Tap the Trigger
perks.desc: Grants a short period of increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.desc: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.desc: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Slideways
perks.desc: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts handling and stability.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.desc: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.desc: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Headseeker
perks.desc: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.

perks.name: Kickstart
perks.desc: Gain bonus damage and charge rate during a slide after sprinting for a short duration.

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.desc: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Reservoir Burst
perks.desc: When the battery is full, your next burst deals additional damage and causes enemies to explode on death.

perks.name: Offhand Strike
perks.desc: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for a short duration.

perks.name: Jolting Feedback
perks.desc:
Dealing repeated damage with this weapon inflicts Jolt. 

While amplified, Jolt is applied faster.

perks.name: Fleet Footed
perks.desc: Dealing damage grants you a short window of increased movement speed and airborne effectiveness. Landing a final blow increases these effects.

perks.name: Roar of Battle
perks.desc: Being in combat for a short duration increases handling and stability.

perks.name: Wild Card
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon have a chance to create experimental submunitions at the target's location.

notes: Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-SustainedDamage PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): Backup PvE roll for sustained DPS against a single yellow-bar target in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty. Willful Hamartia is an adaptive burst linear fusion rifle, which are rated D-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic being "worse DPS than even upper-middle special weapons and no access to ammo return perks". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, fires a 3-round burst as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The stats are good by comparison with its peers - you can see them at https://destiny.report/w/1952295804/willful-hamartia and hopefully https://d2foundry.gg/w/1952295804 will show how weapon stats impact in-game performance when the site is back up and running. The recoil direction is vertical and reasonably tight so you could improve recoil control or just look to boost Stability to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. As the battery perk, Accelerated Coils improves charge time by 40ms at the cost of ×0.98 base damage, or Enhanced Battery with Backup Mag in the battery perk slot gets you the maximum of 7 shots. To be honest, adaptive burst LFRs are a weak subfamily for boss damage but, if you insist, in the first trait perk column, Envious Assassin overflows the battery to up to ×3 capacity at 10% of mag size per kill with primary weapons and 20% with specials (12.5%/22.5% when enhanced) before readying, during add phases. For damage, in the second column Bait and Switch boosts damage by ×1.3 for 10s (11s when enhanced) for doing damage with your other two weapons, or Reservoir Burst provides a ×1.3 (×1.33 when enhanced) damage boost when the battery is at or above maximum base capacity and triggers an AoE explosion on a kill, as well as passively granting +30 to Battery Capacity - the equivalent of a Backup Mag mod. Alternatively, Precision Instrument grants up to ×6 stacks of escalating damage on repeated crit hits up to a max ×1.25 (×1.3 enhanced) for 1.25s or until you miss a crit, or Jolting Feedback applies Arc Jolt after 4 hits (3 enhanced or when amplified) to tougher enemies who can survive the weapon damage, triggering chain lightning on further hits for both target and AoE damage and useful for others on your fireteam using Aggregate Charge weapons. For a burst damage roll, the Roar of Battle origin trait is probably most useful, granting +10 Stability and Handling for 6s after dealing or taking damage every 0.5s or so for 2s. Against Elites, Champions and Minibosses, Wild Card provides the chance of Telesto-like "Experimental Submunitions" dropping on a kill - the number depends on the enemy tier - that last up to 10.5s and explode on contact or proximity to an enemy. The least useful for this roll is Fleet Footed, which stacks up to ×1 on hits and ×2 on kills to boost movement speed and Airborne Effectiveness for a refreshable 5s (6s enhanced). If you're interested, hamartia is an ancient Greek term meaning a fatal flaw, error in judgment, or "missing the mark" (originally used in archery) that brings about a hero's downfall in classical tragedy, so "Willful Hamartia" essentially translates to a deliberate fatal mistake or chosen tragic flaw. Instead of a tragic hero accidentally stumbling into their doom, it implies choosing the path of error with open eyes. Recommended MW: Charge Time, with a Charge Time or Backup Mag mod or your preferred choice to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.
